scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:hardening:apply && npm run docker:sync && docker compose up --force-recreate
scripts.docker:share: npm run docker:hardening:apply && npm run docker:sync && docker compose up --force-recreate
scripts.docker:apps:up: npm run docker:hardening:apply && docker compose stop fahrer koordinator admin planner || true && npm run docker:sync && docker compose up -d --force-recreate fahrer koordinator admin planner && (docker compose ps tunnel >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose up -d --force-recreate tunnel || true)
scripts.docker:apps:down: docker compose stop fahrer koordinator admin planner
scripts.docker:osm:up: npm run docker:osm:prepare && docker compose --profile osm up -d osm-osrm osm-nominatim
scripts.docker:osm:down: docker compose --profile osm stop osm-osrm osm-nominatim
scripts.docker:osm:logs: docker compose --profile osm logs -f osm-osrm osm-nominatim
